title: Return of Serve Mechanics (Michelle Grogan)
style: progressive trance 132bpm female whisper vocal tribal drums djembe congas taiko horns brass stabs animal calls bird whoop wolf howl ambient pads English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Whisper intro]
Three feet behind the line
Low stance ready
Eyes on the toss
Read their paddle face

[Whisper verse]
Feet shoulder width plus
Weight on the front feet
Split step at their contact
Grip pressure four out of ten

Contact in front of the body
Waist height window
Low to mid swing path
Flat face square at impact

[Tribal drop chant]
Deep return deep return
Center line center line
Vamos firme pa lante
Deep return deep return

[Whisper verse]
Target the back third
Center of their court
Medium pace flat trajectory
Clear the net by four feet

Follow through to the target
Move to the kitchen line
Four quick steps forward
Breath out and ready paddle

[Tribal drop chant]
Deep return deep return
Center line center line
Vamos firme pa lante
Deep return deep return

[Whisper outro]
Deep middle
Move forward
Deep middle
Move forward
